assessment: This paper will be of interest to a broad range of scientists in the regeneration field as it builds on and complements several recent mouse digit tip regeneration single-cell RNAseq data sets. This study applies the emerging field of spatial transcriptomics to overlay gene expression information on the spatial arrangement of regenerating cells over time. The authors use their data to address several important questions related to regeneration such as "can we define a molecular signature for regenerating cells?" and "why does regenerative ability decline with age?
